definitions.gloss: visitor; caller; person who comes to visit
definitions.explanation: Used in business, official, and written contexts.

examples.japanese: {来訪|らいほう}{者|しゃ}は{受付|うけつけ}で{記帳|きちょう}してください。
examples.english: Visitors, please sign in at the reception desk.

examples.japanese: {本日|ほんじつ}の{来訪|らいほう}{者|しゃ}は{三十名|さんじゅうめい}でした。
{来訪|らいほう}{者|しゃ}には{入館|にゅうかん}カードを{発行|はっこう}し、{退館|たいかん}{時|じ}に{返却|へんきゃく}していただいています。
examples.english: Visitors are issued an entry card, which they return upon leaving.

notes:
Composed of {来訪|らいほう} (visit, calling) + {者|しゃ} (person). A formal word for a visitor, particularly one who comes to an office, institution, or other official setting. More formal than {訪問者|ほうもんしゃ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {来訪|らいほう}{者|しゃ}を{迎|むか}える: to receive a visitor
- {来訪|らいほう}{者|しゃ}{記録|きろく}: visitor log
- {来訪|らいほう}{者|しゃ}{用|よう}{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}: visitor parking
- {来訪|らいほう}{者|しゃ}の{対応|たいおう}: handling visitors

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {訪問者|ほうもんしゃ}: visitor (slightly less formal, more general)
- お{客様|きゃくさま}: guest, customer (honorific, broader usage)
- {来客|らいきゃく}: visitor, guest (commonly used for home or office visitors)
- {参拝者|さんぱいしゃ}: shrine or temple visitor (religious context)
